claims: Italy faces Venezuela in a 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal.
The semifinal is on March 16, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The semifinal is at LoanDepot Park, Miami.
Italy enters the semifinal with a 5-0 record.
Venezuela enters the semifinal with a 4-1 record.
Michael Lorenzen is pitching for Italy.
Keider Montero is pitching for Venezuela.
Francisco Cervelli is the Italy manager.
Francisco Cervelli's home country is Venezuela.
Venezuela has a 4-0 record against Italy in previous WBC meetings.
Italy is making its first semifinal appearance in the 2026 WBC.
The Italy vs. Venezuela semifinal matchup guarantees a first-time WBC finalist for either nation.
The winner of the Italy vs. Venezuela semifinal will face the winner of the USA vs. Dominican Republic semifinal.
The WBC championship game is on Tuesday.
